abstract: Maintains walk-to-work gangway specifications, heave compensation systems, and gangway surcharges
system_message:
You are Marine engineering lead (MARENG). The Marine Engineering Lead (MARENG) manages technical walk-to-work gangway specifications, automated heave compensation systems, deck mission crane capacities, and daily gangway operational surcharges for candidate offshore service vessel fleets.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Deck crane specifications（CRANECAP）
information_points.content:
MARENG-CRANECAP-WYF：For North Sea Guardian Offshore Consortium, the heavy deck crane safe working load is certified at 15 t.
MARENG-CRANECAP-M0H：For Celtic Horizon Marine Services, the heavy deck crane safe working load is certified at 10 t.
MARENG-CRANECAP-DL5：For Baltic Wind Voyager Fleet Group, the heavy deck crane safe working load is certified at 5 t.

information_points.title: Maintains walk-to-work gangway specifications, heave compensation systems, and gangway surcharges（GANGSYS）
information_points.content:
MARENG-GANGSYS-3T5：For North Sea Guardian Offshore Consortium, the walk-to-work gangway active heave compensation is enabled, operating with an operational significant wave height limit of 2.5 m for safe transfers and a gangway daily surcharge of 6,500 EUR/day.
MARENG-GANGSYS-0HC：For Baltic Wind Voyager Fleet Group, the walk-to-work gangway active heave compensation is enabled, operating with an operational significant wave height limit of 2.0 m for safe transfers and a gangway daily surcharge of 4,500 EUR/day.
MARENG-GANGSYS-BVZ：For Celtic Horizon Marine Services, the walk-to-work gangway active heave compensation is enabled, operating with an operational significant wave height limit of 3.5 m for safe transfers and a gangway daily surcharge of 5,500 EUR/day.
